name: MC Advanced Info Fetch
description: Read-only HTTP endpoints on 127.0.0.1:3421 that report the player position, facing, vitals and status effects (/info), the carried inventory, offhand, armor and any open furnace or chest (/inventory), every chat line since the previous request (/msg) and every sound played since the previous request (/sound) as plain technical text. Split out of mcctl.
